title: Awesomely Creamy Polish Taleggio Noodles
description: A tangy and creamy Polish dish featuring taleggio cheese, perfect for a hangover cure, and made Jain-friendly by using vegetable broth and avoiding any animal-derived ingredients.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the eggless noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
Drain the noodles and set them aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the softened taleggio cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the cheese sauce.
Season the noodles with salt and black pepper to taste.
Divide the noodles into individual portions and shape each portion into a nigiri shape.
Garnish each portion with chopped fresh parsley.
